name: Crusaders without a Cross: Biopolitical and Secular Reconfiguration of Cosmic War.
headline: Crusaders without a Cross: Biopolitical and Secular Reconfiguration of Cosmic War.
description: The article offers the insights of American scholar Mark Juergensmeyer which include understanding contemporary terrorism, resurgence of religious identity, and the motif of cosmic war.
